data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   -t 01:30:00
#   -N 3
#   --ntasks-per-node=4
#   --ntasks-per-socket=2
#   --gres=gpu:4
#   -c 4
#   --mem-per-cpu=0

# Map to Flux: 3 nodes, 12 tasks total (4 per node), 4 cores per task.
#flux: -N 3
#flux: -n 12
#flux: -c 4
#flux: --time-limit=90m

# Omitted Slurm option: --gres=gpu:4
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without GPUs (or fewer than 4), causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted Slurm option: --ntasks-per-node=4 and --ntasks-per-socket=2 (placement constraints)
# Flux does not have universally portable directives for these placement constraints.
# Performance implication: rank placement/NUMA locality may differ, potentially reducing performance.

# Omitted Slurm option: --mem-per-cpu=0
# Flux memory requests/limits are site/config dependent; no universally portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: memory constraints may differ under Flux site configuration.

export PYTHONHASHSEED=0
module load anaconda
source activate pppl
module load cudatoolkit/8.0
module load cudnn/cuda-8.0/6.0
module load openmpi/cuda-8.0/intel-17.0/2.1.0/64
module load intel/17.0/64/17.0.4.196 intel-mkl/2017.3/4/64

rm -f /tigress/$USER/model_checkpoints/*
rm -f /tigress/$USER/results/*
rm -f /tigress/$USER/csv_logs/*
rm -f /tigress/$USER/Graph/*
rm -f /tigress/$USER/normalization/*

export OMPI_MCA_btl="tcp,self,sm"

# Slurm used srun; under Flux, use flux-run to launch 12 ranks.
flux run -n 12 -c 4 python mpi_learn.py

reasons: The original Slurm job required GPUs (`--gres=gpu:4`) but the Flux resource section does not request any GPU resources; on GPU-managed systems this may allocate CPU-only resources and the job may fail or run much slower.
The original Slurm job specified memory policy (`--mem-per-cpu=0`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request/policy; memory constraints may differ under Flux site configuration.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH -t 01:30:00
#SBATCH -N 3
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=4
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-socket=2
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:4
#SBATCH -c 4
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=0

export PYTHONHASHSEED=0
module load anaconda
source activate pppl
module load cudatoolkit/8.0
module load cudnn/cuda-8.0/6.0
module load openmpi/cuda-8.0/intel-17.0/2.1.0/64
module load intel/17.0/64/17.0.4.196 intel-mkl/2017.3/4/64

#remove checkpoints for a benchmark run
rm /tigress/$USER/model_checkpoints/*
rm /tigress/$USER/results/*
rm /tigress/$USER/csv_logs/*
rm /tigress/$USER/Graph/*
rm /tigress/$USER/normalization/*

export OMPI_MCA_btl="tcp,self,sm"

srun python mpi_learn.py
